-
Accused No.1 in Crime No.113 of 2023 of Madanapalle II Town Police Station, Annamayya District,
filed the present Criminal Petition, under Sections 437 and 439 of Cr.P.C., seeking his release on bail.

entities.text: Madanapalle II Town Police Station, Annamayya District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The above crime was registered against the petitioner herein and others for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 365, 342, 354(A), 376(1), 406, 420, 506 r/w 34 IPC and Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s), 3(1)(w)(i), 3(2)(v), 3(2)(va) of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

entities.text: Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Case of the prosecution in brief is that, the de-facto complainant is a resident of Madenapalle town and the mother of the de-facto complainant is working in medical department at Kuwait.
The marriage of the de-facto complainant was fixed with one Satya Viswas, resident of Warangal on 07.10.2021.
The de- facto complainant was introduced to the petitioner on 09.05.2022 by one of her friend and from then onwards both of them used to talk with each other.
On 08.07.2022, de-facto complainant intends to go to Bangalore to attend birthday function of her friend, having come to know of the same, petitioner took her in his car.
Subsequently, the de-facto complainant moved to various places with the petitioner.
They also had physical relationship with each other.
The petitioner and de-facto complainant used to visit various cities.
Subsequently, the marriage of the de-facto complainant was cancelled with the said Satya Viswas.
Even thereafter, petitioner and the de-facto complainant went to various places.
It is alleged that subsequently, the petitioner refused to marry the de-facto complainant, on the ground that she belongs to Scheduled Caste community.
On the basis of the said report, the present case has been filed.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that even according to the First Information Report,
the de-facto complainant voluntarily went along with petitioner to various places.
He further contends that the petitioner was arrested on 17.06.2023 and ever since, he has been in judicial custody.
He also contends that the entire investigation has been completed and the police also filed the charge sheet and as such, he requests this Court to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
4. On the other hand, the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor, on instructions, states that the police have already filed the charge sheet in the present case.

sentences.text:
In view of the above said facts and circumstances, as the petitioner was arrested on 17.06.2023 and as the police already filed charge sheet, this Court inclined to grant bail to the petitioner on certain conditions:
(i) The petitioner herein shall be released on bail on his executing a personal bond for Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with two sureties for a like sum each to the satisfaction of the First Additional Judicial Magistrate of I Class,
Madanapalli.
(ii) On release, the petitioner is directed not to hamper the investigation and tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
6.

entities.text:
First Additional Judicial Magistrate of I Class,
Madanapalli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is allowed.
